MI_Culture_Rock_A.note: red canyon rock: the temple niche

MI_Culture_Stone_C.note: pale dressed limestone drums and spire

MI_Culture_SpireStone_C.note: older, weathered grey limestone: the spire

placement.A: Stack houses up slopes on ATerraceStair blocks (TerraceTop socket); every house wears A2/A3RoofDome* so its roof is the terrace of the house above; A*Ornament on each front door; ACistern on every 2nd-3rd terrace; ATempleNiche replaces the Age2/Age3 temple facade (set against the slope). Host walls: MI_Age*_Structure_A.
placement.B: Every house stands on B*Stilts* (HostBase socket, deck +1.8 m over water) and wears B*RoofSaddle*; houses cluster in rings of 5-8 round open water courts linked by BWalkwayCurve / BWalkwayStraight and BBridge over channels; BGardenRaft scattered on the water; BBreakwater segments along the seaward side; BTempleSpiral at the centre (replaces the temple).
placement.C: Houses are C*DrumHouse + C*RoofCone (or rectangular hosts with C<age>Roof<Host>) snapped to concentric rings round a central plaza; CRingWallCurve between rings, CRingWallStraight along the radial streets; CSpire at the centre beside the granary; CStandingStone1-3 along the approach road.
